title: Cervix
summary: The cervix is the narrow lower end of the uterus that opens into the top of the vagina. It lets menstrual blood out and sperm in, and dilates during childbirth.
key_points: Pap smears and HPV tests check cervical cells for changes linked to cervical cancer.
The HPV vaccine greatly reduces cervical cancer risk.
